field.text:
Users cannot reset their password when their email contains a plus sign: the reset link is generated for the address with the plus sign removed, so the mail goes to the wrong mailbox.

Expected: the link is sent to the exact address the user typed.

Acceptance criteria:
- A user with the address ana+test@example.com receives the reset mail.
- A test covers an address with a plus sign.
- Addresses without a plus sign behave as before.
